title.en: The right specialist for each need

text.en: Gum care, root canals, oral surgery, implants, dentures and braces are handled by MDS specialists in each field.
Dr. Suhasini, MDS, brings more than 20 years of clinical experience to planning your care.
We explain what we find, your options and the costs before any treatment begins.
Unhurried appointments, careful technique and attention to your comfort at every step.
Specialists consult on weekday evenings, so you can visit after work or school.
Talk to us in the language you're most comfortable with.
Book online, message us on WhatsApp or call. We'll suggest the right doctor.
A careful check-up, with X-rays if needed, and a clear explanation of what we find.
Options, number of sittings and costs explained — you decide, with no pressure.
Comfortable treatment with the right specialist, then clear aftercare and follow-up.
